publications.title: AutoTrack: A Deep Learning Approach on a Novel Dataset for Vehicle Detection and Route Tracking from CCTV Images
publications.shortDesc: Teaching machines to follow the trail — reconstructing a vehicle's full journey across a city's surveillance network using deep learning.
publications.fullDesc: AutoTrack presents an end-to-end deep learning pipeline for vehicle detection, license plate recognition, and multi-camera route tracking using CCTV footage. The core challenge: given any vehicle, automatically determine where it has been across an entire city's surveillance network. We constructed a novel annotated dataset for this task and developed a system that goes from raw CCTV frames to a fully reconstructed vehicle trajectory — with direct applications in traffic monitoring, hit-and-run investigation, and smart city infrastructure.
